befe78b61f733bfc.description: About the Role Saudi Air Navigation Services (SANS) is seeking a Digital Network Lead to deliver and operate secure, resilient, and high-performance network and CCTV infrastructure. This full-time position, based in Jeddah, requires 3-5 years of experience and is crucial for enabling reliable user and application connectivity across on-premises and cloud environments. Role Purpose and Impact The primary purpose of this role is to ensure continuous availability, security, and compliance of network and CCTV systems through proactive monitoring, automation, incident resolution, and audit readiness. The Digital Network Lead will also maintain integrated video surveillance systems that support operational continuity, privacy, and organizational safety requirements. Key Responsibilities Implement network designs and configurations (LAN/WAN, routing, switching, VLANs) according to architecture blueprints and change control. Deploy and validate network services for new applications and environments, ensuring design intent is realized in production. Operate and maintain network and CCTV infrastructure, monitoring health, performance, and capacity to meet SLAs. Execute capacity planning and performance tuning (QoS, load balancing, bandwidth optimization) for high availability. Act as an escalation point for L2/L3 incidents across network and CCTV domains, performing root cause analysis and implementing permanent fixes. Implement and commission surveillance solutions (cameras, encoders, NVRs/VMS), ensuring adherence to approved architecture and site standards. Configure and maintain network segmentation, VLANs, QoS, and bandwidth profiles to support enterprise traffic and video streams. Implement and enforce security controls across network and CCTV environments (firewalls, segmentation, VPNs, encryption, access controls). Monitor CCTV platform health, troubleshoot device and recording issues, and ensure retention and archival policies are enforced. Provide regular updates to the IT Infrastructure Section Head on infrastructure health, risks, performance, and operational metrics. Maintain runbooks, topology diagrams, configuration baselines, and knowledge artifacts. Coordinate with vendors and service providers for support, upgrades, and escalations. Operational Management and Compliance Perform routine checks (connectivity, device health, storage, firmware) and proactive corrective actions for service continuity. Tune monitoring thresholds, maintain dashboards, and provide operational telemetry for rapid issue detection and resolution. Support high-availability designs, failover testing, and resilience planning to meet RTO/RPO and service availability targets. Coordinate with change and release processes to ensure safe deployments and minimize operational risk. Maintain accurate configuration items in CMDB and enforce configuration baselines. Manage integration of CCTV systems with network and storage platforms, including storage allocation and retention. Apply hardening baselines, support vulnerability remediation, and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. Produce audit evidence and maintain traceability of configurations, access, and changes. Maintain backup and restore procedures for VMS and camera configurations, participating in disaster recovery testing. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement Collaborate with infrastructure, security, application, and vendor teams for integrated and efficient service delivery. Conduct day-to-day activities in compliance with established policies and procedures. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of systems and processes, considering leading practices, business environment changes, cost reduction, and productivity enhancement.

Support Housekeeping management in daily operations and act as a liaison to coordinate efforts between Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry departments. Document and resolve issues related to discrepant rooms in coordination with the Front Desk. Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes in room assignments to relevant staff. Communicate any outstanding issues to the next shift and complete all required paperwork accurately. Assist management with various human resources tasks including hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Ensure compliance with all company and safety and security policies and procedures, reporting any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries. Maintain a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance, uphold confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Communicate professionally and clearly with colleagues, fostering positive working relationships and responding appropriately to concerns. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 55 pounds without assistance, and over 55 pounds with assistance. Capability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Capacity to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to stand, sit, kneel, or walk for extended periods throughout an entire work shift. Proficiency in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Competence in entering and locating work-related information using computers and/or point-of-sale systems, and visually verifying information in various formats. Demonstrated ability to ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic hotel environment. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply to join the Marriott International team and contribute to delivering exceptional hospitality experiences.

be6749ac027100e8.description: نبذة عن الشركة والدور TruckMate Information Technology هي منشأة سعودية تقنية مقرها الدمام، متخصصة في تطوير نظام ERP متكامل لشركات النقل والخدمات اللوجستية. يغطي النظام جوانب متعددة مثل إسناد الرحلات، التتبع المباشر للأسطول، سندات التسليم الإلكترونية، إدارة الورشة وقطع الغيار، والموارد البشرية والرواتب. تبحث الشركة عن مندوب مبيعات ميداني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينتي الدمام والرياض، بخبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. مهام الوظيفة يتولى مندوب المبيعات الميداني مسؤولية تعريف الشركات المستهدفة بنظام TruckMate ومتابعتها حتى إتمام توقيع العقود. تشمل المهام الرئيسية ما يلي: بناء قائمة بالشركات المستهدفة في المنطقة المحددة، والوصول إلى صناع القرار فيها. زيارة الشركات ميدانياً لفهم طريقة إدارتها لأسطولها وعملياتها. ترتيب وتقديم عروض تجريبية للنظام بدعم من فريق TruckMate. متابعة العملاء المحتملين حتى مرحلة التفاوض وتوقيع العقد. تسجيل الزيارات والعملاء في سجل المتابعة، وإرسال تقرير يومي مختصر. تحقيق المستهدفات الأسبوعية من الزيارات والعروض التجريبية. نقل ملاحظات العملاء من الميدان للمساهمة في تطوير النظام. المؤهلات والمتطلبات لشغل هذا الدور، يجب أن تتوفر في المرشح المؤهلات والمتطلبات التالية: خبرة في المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع النقل أو الخدمات اللوجستية أو مبيعات الأنظمة. وجود علاقات مع شركات نقل أو مقاولات أو توزيع يعتبر ميزة إضافية. رخصة قيادة سارية وسيارة خاصة. القدرة على العمل باستقلالية في الميدان. طبيعة العمل والمزايا تتميز طبيعة العمل بالمرونة، حيث يتم توثيق العقد عبر منصة قوى. يوفر الدور عمولة مجزية على كل عقد يتم توقيعه، مع دخل مفتوح بدون سقف، وحرية في تنظيم الوقت وجدول الزيارات. كما يتم توفير تدريب كامل على النظام، وحساب تجريبي للعروض، وملفات تعريفية جاهزة لدعم مندوب المبيعات. تفاصيل إضافية هذا الدور متاح بنظام العقد، ويقدم راتباً يتراوح بين 5,625 ريال سعودي و 7,500 ريال سعودي.

be7d50ca30357f44.description: About the Role Evercare is seeking a Pharmacist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. be0c9210f395e9e3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة شذى حسن الحارثي للتصميم الداخلي عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المستندات المالية، متابعة الإيرادات، إعداد القيود المحاسبية، وتدقيق الحسابات البنكية لضمان دقة السجلات المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد التقارير المالية. مهارات تحليلية لتوثيق وتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق المؤسسة لدعم العمليات المالية وضمان الامتثال للمعايير المحاسبية. ملخص الدور يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية شاملة عن الجوانب المحاسبية، بدءًا من تدقيق المطالبات المالية وصولاً إلى إعداد التقارير الختامية. يهدف الدور إلى تعزيز الكفاءة المالية للمؤسسة من خلال تطبيق أفضل الممارسات المحاسبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

be12f567dbb4a908.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فاد الخليجيه للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، والإشراف على تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بشكل دقيق. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية. الالتزام بتطبيق إجراءات السلامة المهنية. الدقة في تقدير الكميات ومطابقة المواصفات. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكهرباء في بيئة عمل ديناميكية ضمن مشاريع شركة فاد الخليجيه للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المواقع المحددة لتنفيذ المهام. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

be7b60258fa0ca43.description: About Mutakamela Insurance Mutakamela Insurance is a growing leader in the insurance sector within Saudi Arabia. The company focuses on attracting and developing talent to support its continued success and expansion. Mutakamela operates with a culture rooted in professionalism, innovation, and collaboration. Position Overview Mutakamela Insurance is seeking an Assistant Procurement Manager to join its procurement team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience, with a strong background in the insurance industry. The successful candidate will manage the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from strategic vendor sourcing to supplier performance management, operating with autonomy to establish vendor relationships and drive cost-effective strategies. Key Responsibilities Execute the complete purchasing lifecycle, including requisition review, RFP/RFQ management, negotiation, purchase order issuance, and contract administration. Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic vendors and service providers tailored to insurance and corporate requirements (*, loss adjusters, medical networks, IT infrastructure, legal counsel, and third-party administrators). Conduct commercial negotiations on pricing, payment terms, SLAs, and contract conditions to secure optimal value. Direct the end-to-end vendor onboarding process, including registration, pre-qualification, financial screening, and compliance verification. Establish and maintain a comprehensive database of qualified vendors, ensuring all commercial registrations (CR), certifications, and licenses remain up to date. Implement vendor performance evaluation frameworks (KPIs/SLAs) and conduct periodic reviews to ensure continuous service quality and compliance. Leverage domain knowledge of insurance operations to align procurement practices with local regulatory standards, including SAMA/Insurance Authority guidelines where applicable. Assess third-party vendor risks, ensuring data privacy, information security, and financial stability standards are met. Coordinate with internal risk, compliance, and legal teams to draft, review, and finalize vendor agreements. Manage daily procurement operations independently with minimal supervision, taking initiative on complex sourcing tasks. Collaborate with internal business units to understand procurement needs, define specifications, and manage expectations. Track procurement metrics, maintain accurate records, and generate regular spend and sourcing analysis reports for senior management. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in procurement. Strong background and understanding of the Insurance Industry. Demonstrated ability to manage the full procurement lifecycle autonomously. Knowledge of local market dynamics and regulatory standards in Saudi Arabia. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves operating with a high degree of autonomy within the procurement team. Application Process Mutakamela Insurance is committed to building a strong, capable workforce. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

A minimum of 2 years of related experience, including supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. be2d8da9adf0b7b5.description: About the Role Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG) is seeking a Consultant Gastroenterologist to provide high-standard clinical care and expertise in the assessment, investigation, diagnosis, and treatment of patients with gastroenterological conditions. be37d090a317e42d.description: About the Role Nawras Power Company LLC is seeking a Control Room Engineer to join their team in An Nu'ayriyah, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is critical for operating and monitoring the power plant through the Distributed Control System (DCS), ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient electricity generation. The role supports all phases of plant operation, from commissioning to emergency response, while adhering to strict operating procedures and HSE standards. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor gas turbines, steam turbines, heat recovery steam generators (HRSGs), and associated auxiliary systems via the DCS. Execute plant startups, shutdowns, load changes, and equipment changeovers according to approved procedures. Monitor operating parameters, identify abnormal conditions, and implement corrective actions within authorized limits. Maintain generation output in line with dispatch instructions and plant operating capabilities. Respond promptly to alarms, equipment trips, and emergencies, coordinating with the Shift Supervisor and field operators. Direct field operators during equipment inspections, local operations, testing, and troubleshooting. Monitor plant efficiency, fuel consumption, equipment performance, and emissions, reporting deviations and improvement opportunities. Coordinate equipment availability, maintenance preparation, and return to service with operations and maintenance teams. Identify equipment defects, raise maintenance notifications, and follow up on outstanding operational issues. Support equipment isolation, permit-to-work, and lockout/tagout activities within assigned authorization. Maintain accurate control room logs, shift reports, operating records, and incident or trip reports. Conduct thorough shift handovers, highlighting equipment status, operating restrictions, ongoing maintenance, and outstanding risks. Support commissioning tests, performance tests, and the transition of plant systems into commercial operation. Participate in emergency drills, safety meetings, incident investigations, and operational training. Comply with Nawras Power Company policies, HSE requirements, environmental limits, and approved operating procedures. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant role. Demonstrated ability to operate and monitor power plant systems using a Distributed Control System (DCS). Strong understanding of gas turbines, steam turbines, heat recovery steam generators (HRSGs), and associated auxiliary systems. Proficiency in executing plant startups, shutdowns, and load changes. Knowledge of HSE standards and operating procedures in a power plant environment. Work Environment This is a site-based position located in An Nu'ayriyah. The role requires working rotating shifts, which include nights, weekends, and public holidays. Participation in emergency response and operational training is also required as needed.

Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership to a multi-disciplined team, including FSM, FOM, ME Program Manager, and specialists in Service, Projects, and Support. Ensure the organization achieves strategic growth objectives by attracting, developing, rewarding, and retaining necessary skills and resources for the LCM Program. Manage all financial aspects of projects within Capex scope and contracts within Opex scope, including orders, revenue, margin, and billing. Deploy growth initiatives and partner with other Honeywell business units as the focal person for all Honeywell Systems installed in the Yanbu area. Collaborate with the Sales team to drive additional orders and capitalize on business opportunities. Develop and establish operational plans with the Field Service Manager and Field Operations Manager. Communicate with customers according to contract-specific communication plans. Support the Service team in resolving incidents and troubleshooting problems, including managing escalation processes. Review system performance metrics and manage accordingly. Manage all projects in Capex scope and all contract entitlements and deliverables in Opex scope for the respective year. Work within the customer’s change management process, serving as an approver for significant change requests and including operational risk/benefit assessments. Participate in pre-outage planning meetings and support all migrations. Review and advise on project activities affecting the control system and ensure documentation is updated. Support the Field Operations Manager in developing and communicating training needs to improve system performance or reliability. Manage third-party underpinning contracts to ensure cost-effective, quality, and timely performance. Partner with the FOM and Quality Assurance team to manage the close-out of corrective actions by identifying root causes and updating procedures. About Honeywell Honeywell is a global company focused on innovation across various sectors, including aerospace, building technologies, and performance materials. The company fosters a culture that values inclusion, diversity, and continuous personal development.

be6749aae2dd52ce.description: About the Role Air Arabia is seeking a First Officer A320 to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role involves conducting assigned flights in accordance with the Airline Operational Manual and relevant civil aviation authority regulations. The First Officer is responsible for ensuring ultimate safety, security, and efficiency across all flights, supporting the flight and cabin crew, and effectively managing emergencies and ad-hoc scenarios. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to operate assigned flights, prioritizing safety, security, and efficiency. The First Officer guides the flight and cabin crew, manages unforeseen situations, and maintains control of the flight to ensure successful performance and uphold the corporate image. Key Responsibilities Operate assigned aircraft according to schedules and approved flight plans, assuming ultimate responsibility for the aircraft with priority given to safety, efficiency, and passenger comfort. Ensure all flights adhere to the Airline’s Operations Manual and regulations, continuously implementing and monitoring procedures for safe and smooth operations. Confirm timely attendance, proper grooming, fitness, and legal compliance for self and flight crew before assigned flights, conducting pre-flight briefings as per adopted procedures. Liaise with co-pilots and the Dispatch Team prior to each flight to ensure crew members are prepared with necessary information, including aircraft technical status, route preferences, weather, fuel, and role distribution. Ensure efficient and effective fuel usage during flights, within the safety constraints detailed in the Airline’s Operations Manual. Oversee required safety, security, fuel, and transit checks for each flight, directing crew actions in case of irregularities and escalating issues when necessary. Collaborate with Maintenance Engineers to confirm aircraft technical status and suitability for flight, seeking support from MCC and MROs for concerns or defects, and implementing rectifications immediately. Ensure all necessary documents and technical logs are accurately completed and loaded according to Airline and civil aviation authority regulations. Confirm that the Airline Operations Manual is distributed, maintained, kept up-to-date, understood, and complied with by Flight Crew. Stay informed on legal requirements from regulatory bodies such as civil aviation authorities and Airbus Company, relevant to flights and flight crew. Undertake additional ground-based tasks, such as Safety Officer or Security Officer, as directed by the line manager and in accordance with the Airline’s Operations Manual. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant aviation role. Demonstrated ability to operate flights in compliance with operational manuals and civil aviation regulations. Strong understanding of flight safety, security, and efficiency protocols. Proficiency in handling emergencies and ad-hoc scenarios effectively. Excellent communication and leadership skills to guide flight and cabin crew. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Dammam. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary information for this role is not disclosed.

be80229436bb9550.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة البركات عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير تجربة استقبال ممتازة للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم السجلات الإدارية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعتبر فرصة مثالية للمبتدئين لبناء مسارهم المهني في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية، والرد على الاستفسارات العامة، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة أو تنسيق المهام. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية ولباقة. مهارات اتصال ممتازة شفهية وكتابية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة بفعالية. القدرة على استخدام أنظمة الاتصالات المكتبية. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الاستقبال بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بالرياض. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع الزوار والعملاء، بالإضافة إلى التنسيق المستمر مع الأقسام الداخلية لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في مجموعة البركات.

Support the development and submission of competitive proposals, Expressions of Interest (EOIs), and RFP responses for prospective clients. Maintain and update the business development opportunities pipeline and tracking records. Build and maintain relationships with external clients, contractors, and prospective partners. Coordinate with internal departments (technical, operations, legal, finance) to ensure proposals are accurate and compliant with applicable standards and regulations. beb86b1bca46afc5.description: About Jasara Program Management Company Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a joint venture between the Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco. The company provides program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, supporting the delivery of giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. Role Overview Jasara PMC is seeking a Senior Design Manager - MEP (Electrical) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing consultant-led electrical and power system design activities across all project stages. The Senior Design Manager ensures designs comply with project requirements, approved design briefs, Scopes of Work (SOW), applicable electrical standards, and authority regulations. The position provides technical leadership and design governance for electrical engineering disciplines and ensures coordination with other disciplines to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient solutions. Key Responsibilities Oversee and coordinate electrical and power system design activities through concept, schematic, detailed design, and construction documentation stages. Lead design governance processes, including design reviews, technical compliance reviews, change management, and stage-gate approvals. Ensure electrical designs comply with relevant standards, including Saudi Building Code, SEC requirements, IEC, NFPA, and international best practices. Manage electrical, MEP, and multidisciplinary consultants, reviewing submissions for technical solutions, operational efficiency, and maintainability. Provide technical oversight for the design and integration of MV/LV infrastructure, substations, emergency power systems, street lighting, and smart city electrical infrastructure. Act as the primary electrical design interface across all disciplines, ensuring integration with architectural, structural, mechanical, ICT, security, transportation, and utility infrastructure designs. Review engineering calculations, electrical studies (*, load demand, short circuit, arc flash), and design reports. Align electrical designs with approved budgets, lead value engineering reviews, and identify technical risks and mitigation measures. Support design-to-construction transitions, technical queries, shop drawing reviews, and site coordination activities. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering is required. A Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or Engineering Management is preferred. Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience in electrical engineering design and project delivery, with at least 7 years in senior design management or leadership roles. Project Experience: Proven experience managing consultant-led design teams on large-scale mixed-use developments, cities, infrastructure, airports, metros, utilities, theme parks, or giga-projects. Technical Expertise: Extensive experience with power distribution systems, LV/MV infrastructure, substations, switchgear, and critical electrical systems. Regional Experience: Experience in Saudi Arabia or GCC mega-project developments is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a program management company focused on delivering large-scale projects.

beba504f7aab5c68.description: About the Role Kerten Hospitality is seeking a Waiter/Waitress for Dar Tantora, The House Hotel, located in Al Ula. bef01d8c51de3db1.description: About Deutsche Bank's Private Bank Division Deutsche Bank AG is seeking a Client Service Executive for its Private Bank division in Riyadh. The division aims to create lasting value for wealthy individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices, and foundations by developing bespoke solutions such as intergenerational wealth planning, asset management with individual risk management, loans, and deposits, supported by a global network and collaboration with the Corporate Bank, Investment Bank, and DWS. This role acts as the primary point of contact for RMs and clients regarding operational requests, requiring liaison with key onshore and offshore stakeholders including Cross Border, CLM, and Business Management. The executive is responsible for the timely execution of requests and resolution of issues to meet client and RM requirements. Key Responsibilities Handle and respond to RM requests and client queries related to account documentation, balances, maintenance, statement information, and general product/service information. Attend client meetings with RMs when necessary to provide support. Assist RMs in the new account opening process, including preparing comprehensive account opening packs for submission to the CLM team. Review and prepare client-signed quality packs, including Booking Centre documents, for submission to the local CLM team for new account openings. Liaise with CLM/AFC/OBS/KYC Review Teams for follow-up or to provide additional information/documentation. Promptly address Booking Centre/Regulatory document deficiencies to support RMs in achieving Key Risk Indicators (KRIs). Ensure timely completion of all operational tasks related to client accounts to maintain satisfactory service levels. Provide timely assistance in inputting call reports (from RMs) and ensuring proper record retention in protected Group shared folders. Maintain current and thorough knowledge of operational processes, services, and firm systems/applications. Develop an understanding of the governing regulatory framework and uphold relevant policies/procedures to mitigate risks and protect the Bank. Support RMs in client after-sales tasks and coordinate marketing event invitations and approvals. Manage the daily mailing of documentation to relevant booking centres, where applicable. Foster strong working relationships across coverage, product, and infrastructure divisions. Participate in all AM group projects and meetings. Handle regulatory and non-regulatory projects within stipulated deadlines. Liaise with IT for arranging video conference meetings/calls. Support and Development Deutsche Bank is committed to supporting its employees through various initiatives. This includes offering flexible working arrangements to help balance personal priorities, providing coaching and support from experienced team members, and fostering a culture of continuous learning to aid career progression. Employees also benefit from a range of flexible benefits that can be tailored to individual needs, alongside training and development opportunities designed to enhance career growth.

والسنوية وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. مراجعة التسويات البنكية ومطابقة أرصدة الحسابات بشكل دوري. متابعة حسابات العملاء والموردين والذمم المدينة والدائنة وأعمار الديون. متابعة الحسابات المتعلقة بالمشاريع المعتمدة. معالجة الفروقات والأخطاء المحاسبية ومتابعة تصحيحها. إعداد التقارير المحاسبية ورفعها بشكل دوري إلى المدير المالي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة بكالوريوس محاسبة. خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 7 سنوات في الأنظمة المحاسبية وبرامج ERP وMicrosoft Excel بمستوى متقدم. القدرة على اكتشاف الأخطاء المحاسبية ومعالجتها وإجراء المطابقات والتسويات. مهارات جيدة في إدارة فريق الحسابات وتنظيم العمل. يفضل إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية. الشهادات المهنية مثل SOCPA أو CMA أو ACCA ميزة إضافية وليست شرطًا أساسيًا.
